Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@relaydock.accounting.settlement
role Quote a pinned price revision, authorize a bounded hold, capture provider usage once, and release the unused balance.
owns usage quote lifecycle, money authorization boundary, usage settlement
excludes price catalog persistence, customer ledger storage
invariant Captured provider cost cannot exceed the authorized hold. Every quote identifies the price revision used to calculate its maximum charge.
